SILT#00086: Going through https://jsdate.wtf, I see yet again how convoluted JavaScript is. The crux of the issue is that we've got to recall the rules as decision trees; each choice is a fork we have to take time to resolve, and if the base intuition is wrong, than we have the wrong state of the app
